topic.title: Batch Documents Converter Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Batch Documents Converter add-on enables batch conversions between various document formats, including Word, Excel, Markdown, DITA, XML, JSON, and many more.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
Oxygen XML Developer
Oxygen JSON Editor
body.p: The Batch Documents Converter add-on contributes actions within Oxygen to batch convert between various document formats.
